title: Firefly Learning Action Payload v1
description: Per-launch answer payload for action=answer, written by Firefly to <course>/bridge/learning_action.json before the headless task starts. Firefly only records WHAT the user answered; teach-mcp alone decides what it means (evaluate_answer + record_result).

question_id.description: Verbatim from teach-mcp (echoed through the previous result.json). Never invented by Firefly or the model.

student_answer.description: Raw user text. Verbatim; no judging, no normalization beyond trim.
